messages:
sara_support: Hi team — customer (Alan) says their March invoice is ~3x higher than what their SDK token estimator reported. They sent a minimal repro. Can eng/billing take a look? :eyes:

alan_cust: here’s the repro we used — calling our service via our proxy, SDK estimate shows 420 tokens, invoice shows 1,280. we only send short prompts.

alan_cust: curl we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large-v2","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize: The monthly metrics..."}]}'
```

alan_cust: SDK (node) estimate snippet:
```
const est = sdk.estimateTokens(messages)
// est.total = 420
```

alan_cust: API response usage (server invoice shows):
```
{"usage": {"prompt_tokens": 740, "completion_tokens": 540, "total_tokens": 1280}}
```

devon_billing: thanks, filing as billing-escalation-213100. Can you share request_id from the invoice row? need full meter_n detail to correlate.

alan_cust: request_id=rc_21aFq3z; invoice line id billed_line_3312. sent those over DM.

kai_eng: jumping in. Quick thought — do you include any proxy headers that might inject system or tool prompts? hidden system messages are a common delta. Also check streaming vs non-streaming paths.

jenna_repro: Reproduced locally against sandbox with same payload & key via our proxy. When I hit the endpoint directly (bypassing proxy) estimator vs API usage match ~430 vs 440. When sending via their proxy I see +300 prompt tokens.

jenna_repro: On the proxy trace I see an extra header `x-ctx-system` with value: `You are a metrics summarizer; always include context: <long blob>` — looks like the proxy appends a system instruction which the runtime consumes as prompt.

kai_eng: aha. That matches prompt_tokens delta. Our metering counts any tokens passed into the model input on the server side (including injected system messages). SDK estimator only counts the messages you gave client-side. If a downstream proxy adds system content, that'll increase billed prompt tokens.

emily_devex: note: we should document this more clearly (SDK estimates local-only). But also, are we sure the proxy text is actually sent to the model (not just a header logged)? can you paste the exact backend request before our runtime composes the final messages?

jenna_repro: pasted backend-forward payload (redacted):
```
{"model":"rwd-large-v2","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"system","content":"You are a metrics summarizer; always include context: ... (500 tokens)"},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize: The monthly metrics..."}]}
```

kai_eng: confirmed — there is an additional system message injected by the proxy. Metering is correct here. Two remediation paths: (1) tell customer to remove header injection or (2) add SDK-side warnings / telemetry to surface server-side-injected extras.

devon_billing: For the invoice: given this looks like proxy misconfiguration (third-party middleware injecting content without customer expectation) I'll provisionally issue a one-time credit while they fix their stack — but need confirmation this was unintentional. Alan, can you confirm your infra team added that header?

alan_cust: omg that header was from an internal middleware we deployed last month to enrich prompts for another service. Not intended for this flow. We’ll roll back. Sorry.

sara_support: Good find. Two follow-ups: (a) billing — please do the credit and mark case resolved when done. (b) devex/eng — we should add an inline warning in SDK docs about "server-side added messages can increase billed tokens" and show how to diff estimator vs server usage.

emily_devex: on it — will add a short note and sample script to fetch `usage` from the API response and compare to sdk.estimateTokens().

devon_billing: Credit applied: invoice credit 3312 -> $1,120. Sent confirmation DM. Leaving a note for finance to watch for repeated occurrences. :white_check_mark:

metering_bot: [metering] correlated rc_21aFq3z -> forwarded payload shows 500 extra prompt tokens from injected system message. Marking as external-middleware-inject.

kai_eng: quick technical addendum: there are a few subtle ways deltas happen beyond header injection — e.g., server-side prefixing for safety filters, function/tool call expansions, or post-processing that appends stop sequences. For streaming clients, SDK estimates can undercount when the server appends a trailing stop token that isn't present in the client stream. If you see streaming vs non-streaming variance, ping eng-runtime.

jenna_repro: created a small repro script we can share with customers to diff counts automatically. usage snippet: `const serverUsage = response.usage.total_tokens; const clientEstimate = sdk.estimateTokens(messages).total; console.log(serverUsage - clientEstimate);`

alan_cust: thanks everyone — rolled back the middleware and re-ran. New invoice estimate matches SDK now. Appreciate the quick help and the credit.

sara_support: closing here; documentation update ticket DEVEX-1427 created. great teamwork. :tada:
